purpose: Test whether genuinely semantic candidate-level information is sufficient to remove clearly irrelevant visible Top-5 occupations while preserving useful lower-ranked targets. This is a research oracle, not a runtime design.

retrieval.architecture: current frozen P80 A-family sparse/BM25 candidate

teacher.semantic_policy: drop only when clearly semantically irrelevant under supplied source-bound evidence; insufficient or ambiguous evidence => uncertain

candidate_evidence.note: The compact evidence payload was fixed after two zero-outcome transport failures: first free-tier input-token quota exhaustion, then an array-vs-object JSON envelope parse failure. No parsed/saved oracle judgments existed before this version was frozen. Prompt, model, verdict policy and gates were unchanged.

display_contract.ranks_2_to_5: retain keep and uncertain; remove only drop

primary_evaluation.positive: structured target when present in Top5
primary_evaluation.safe_negative: non-target Top5 candidate in a different SSYK4 from the structured target

primary_gate.only_if_strong_or_promising: Replay exact frozen oracle unchanged on opened user-style stress. No retuning.

opened_replay_acceptance.yv01: remove at least two of Apotekare, Receptarie, Sjukhusvaktmästare while retaining a sjukskoterska-family result
opened_replay_acceptance.yv02: remove both Vaxeltelefonist and Affarskonsult, IT while retaining an elektriker-family result
opened_replay_acceptance.interpretation: diagnostic transfer acceptance/falsification only; never a human accuracy estimate or tuning set

post_gate_decision.if_primary_and_opened_pass: Semantic information has earned a bounded distillation/compilation experiment into a small deterministic runtime-compatible student. Runtime provider LLM/API remains forbidden.
post_gate_decision.if_primary_fails: Do not distill. Reassess semantic evidence/product interaction; do not add another lexical heuristic stack.
post_gate_decision.if_opened_fails: Do not distill from this oracle. Treat proxy-to-user-style transfer as falsified without retuning opened rows.
